steps.title: Bound the prototype
steps.instructions: Reconstructed workflow from the published prompt and available result artifacts; this is not a recorded sequence of agent turns. Use the published prompt to define ten repeating links and joint interfaces in a shallow alternating curve; keep the scope to digital geometry.

steps.title: Build the linked assembly
steps.instructions: Create editable parametric source and a ten-link STEP assembly, then export a GLB preview and the three documented camera views.

steps.title: Inspect the exports
steps.instructions: Follow the prompt checks for link count, solids, spacing and reopening. The existing preview demonstrates inspectable geometry, not locomotion, strength or physical performance.
